SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols base_s ON cb.base_symbol_id = base_s.symbol_id
WHERE f.module = 'core'
  AND f.package = 'click'
  AND s.name = 'Group'
  AND base_s.name = 'Command'
  AND s.qualname = 'Group.group'
  AND base_s.qualname = 'Command.command'
  AND s.line_start >= base_s.line_start
  AND s.line_start <= base_s.line_end
  AND cb.base_name = 'Command'
ORDER BY s.line_start;

JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols base_s ON cb.base_symbol_id = base_s.symbol_id
WHERE f.module = 'core'
  AND f.package = 'click'
  AND s.name = 'Group'
  AND base_s.name = 'Command'
  AND s.qualname = 'Group.group'
  AND base_s.qualname = 'Command.command'
  AND s.line_start >= base_s.line_start
  AND s.line_start <= base_s.line_end
